title: Genomic Landscape of Metastatic Urothelial Cancer in a Multicenter Cohort From Argentina.
snippet: The genomic landscape of advanced urothelial carcinoma (aUC) has enabled the development of targeted therapies; however, real-world data from Latin America remain limited.
